introduction.definition: A pipe spool is a prefabricated assembly of pipe, fittings and flanges welded in a workshop and installed as one piece on site. Shop fabrication gives controlled welding, inspection and coating, shortens site work, and every spool is traceable through its spool number, weld map and inspection records.

classification.type: Prefabricated flanged spool (elbow, tee branch, reducer)

introduction.summary: A pipe spool is a prefabricated section of piping — pipe, fittings and flanges welded together in a shop — that is shipped to site and bolted or welded into the line. Fabricating spools under shop conditions gives better weld quality, inspection and schedule control. Each spool carries a tag with its line and spool number and weld identification for traceability.

foundation: Support pipework at the intervals and on the support types shown on the piping drawings; allow for thermal expansion.

commissioning: Flush/blow the line, then hydrotest or pneumatic test to code.

video_tutorials.title: Pipe Spool — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Pipe Spool.
A pipe spool is a prefabricated assembly of pipe, fittings and flanges welded in a workshop and installed as one piece on site.
Shop fabrication gives controlled welding, inspection and coating, shortens site work, and every spool is traceable through its spool number, weld map and inspection records.
Typical applications include process plants (refineries, alumina, chemicals); power and utility piping; skids and modules; pipeline stations.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Pipe Spool.
Check flange joints for leaks.
Thickness survey at elbows and tees.
Replace gaskets when joints are broken.
Watch for flange leakage: weeping joint. Common cause: uneven bolting, damaged face, wrong gasket.
Watch for weld defect: leak at weld, ndt indication. Common cause: poor fit-up or procedure.
Watch for erosion-corrosion: wall thinning. Common cause: high velocity at elbows.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
